author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: System76 has introduced an updated version of its Thelio Mira desktop, featuring AMD Ryzen 9000 series processors, revised thermal design, and improved serviceability. The system targets workstation, development, and compute-heavy workloads, including data processing and machine learning. title: Thelio Mira Desktop Updated with Ryzen 9000 CPUs and Revised Chassis
